description_en: You can call the GetUser operation to query the details of a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 调用GetUser接口查询RAM用户的详细信息
name: GetUser

parameters.help_en:
The name of the RAM user.

The name is 1 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的名称。

长度为1~64个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: user_name
